answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40802 Country: India Title: Namaz in half sleev shirt Question: Can I offer salah in half sleeve shirt? Is it right or wrong way because people say only satr should be covered during salah? Answer ID: 40802 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1313/1314/M=1433) It is necessary and wajib to cover the satr. It is masnoon to cover the hands along with elbow. It is makrooh to offer salah in half sleeve shirt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
